_comment: Authorization classification for every SECURITY DEFINER function in schemas public and private.
Rebuilt/audited in P0.6 after 20260816130000 was found to use `revoke ... from public` alone,
which no longer strips the CLI's default EXECUTE grant to anon/authenticated.
When you add or change a SECURITY DEFINER function: update this file AND the .test.sql list.
internal_helper: private.upsert_host_document(uuid, text, text)  — called only by private.sync_host_documents_from_application(); revoked from public/anon/authenticated

notes.public.has_scope(text): Added 20260908140000. Backs the scope-gated admin SELECT policies. authenticated_callable is correct: it is an RLS helper (must be executable by the RLS evaluator running as `authenticated`), and a direct caller learns only whether THEY hold a scope — no cross-user disclosure, and inferable anyway from which queries succeed. Same class as is_approved_active_host / current_host_access. NOT service-role-only.
notes.public.host_set_experience_paused(uuid,: Added 20260909150000 (H1 core 1/4). authenticated_callable is correct: it is the only client path to toggle experiences.status published<->paused (direct writes to experiences were revoked from authenticated in 20260823120000). The body re-checks auth.uid(), host_id = auth.uid() ownership, private.is_approved_active_host(auth.uid()), and that the current status permits the toggle. A caller can only affect their own already-published listing; nothing is disclosed. NOT service-role-only.
notes.public.host_update_experience_availabili: Added 20260909160000 (H1 core 2/4). authenticated_callable: the only client path to write experience_departures (authenticated has SELECT only). Body re-checks auth.uid(), experiences.host_id = auth.uid() ownership, private.is_approved_active_host(auth.uid()); targets the earliest open departure (creates one if none); rejects a capacity below the booked count and a date move while active bookings exist. Never touches experiences.status. Affects only the caller's own experience. NOT service-role-only.
notes.public.host_save_experience_draft(jsonb): Added 20260909170000 (H1 core 3/4). authenticated_callable: the only client path to insert/update public.experiences (writes revoked from authenticated in 20260823120000). ONLY ever writes status = 'draft'; refuses to edit a row that is not 'draft'. Body re-checks auth.uid(), private.is_approved_active_host(auth.uid()), and (on update) host_id = auth.uid() ownership. Also rewrites the experience's itinerary_items and upserts its earliest open departure. Server-generates the slug. Affects only the caller's own draft. NOT service-role-only.
notes.public.claim_trip_push_deliveries(uuid): P0.6 fix: 20260816130000 granted it (via weak revoke) to anon+authenticated. 20260908090000 revokes execute from public, anon, authenticated. NOT YET DEPLOYED TO HOSTED — needs a prompt separate hosted deploy.
notes.public.register_trip_push_device / unreg: anon retains a stray EXECUTE from the same weak revoke. Harmless: body raises 'Authentication required' when auth.uid() is null. Left as-is; classified authenticated_callable.
notes.public.get_trip_moderation_queue / revie: anon retains a stray EXECUTE. Harmless: body raises 'Admin access required' unless public.is_admin(). Not tightened in P0.6 to avoid scope creep; tracked as admin_gated_in_body.
notes.trigger_only: EXECUTE grants to anon/authenticated are inert — these take/return `trigger` and cannot be invoked directly with a useful signature.
